surface_mechanism_description: Direct reactions between the earlier deposited oxide layer and the incoming precursor, such as gaseous AlCl3 and as-grown ZrO2, leading to the formation of Al2O3 and volatile ZrCl4.
evidence: The text describes the reaction between gaseous AlCl3 and as-grown ZrO2 as follows: 1.5ZrO2 + 2AlCl3(g) = Al2O3 + 1.5ZrCl4(g), or if AlCl3 exists in dimeric form when evaporated: 1.5ZrO2 + Al2Cl6(g) = Al2O3 + 1.5ZrCl4(g).
